# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- The routes, by name. Speech reaches Mute and Blind, and never Deaf. Gestures
  reach Deaf and Mute, and never Blind. Deaf can speak and gesture, Mute can
  only gesture, Blind can only speak. Check every message against this list
  before you send it.

- Deaf invents the gesture code out loud before anything else moves, and
  everyone else's opening move is waiting for it. The manual's verdict reaches
  Blind only as Deaf's spoken order.

- Whatever the code becomes, it starts by being able to say YES, NO, HOLD and
  DONE. Grow it only when a message will not fit.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have the manual’s sequence, but the protocol requires Deaf to establish the gesture code before any operational message. I will wait for that opening move.

```text
wait()
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Gesture code: thumbs up means YES.
Deaf gestures: [👍]
Deaf says: Gesture code: thumbs down means NO.
Deaf gestures: [👎]
Deaf says: Gesture code: open hand means HOLD.
Deaf gestures: [🖐]
Deaf says: Gesture code: OK sign means DONE.
Deaf gestures: [👌]

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please send me the manual verdict and the exact order for the bomb.
Deaf says to Mute: The verdict was unclear. Please resend it using only the established YES, NO, HOLD, and DONE gestures, with HOLD between each item.

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Resend the manual verdict as 8-bit ASCII. Encode each character as exactly 8 gestures: thumbs up is 1, thumbs down is 0. Use open hand between characters and OK sign only after the final character. Do not use any other gesture.

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Your resend is malformed: the second byte has seven gestures. Please resend exactly eight binary gestures per character, with one open-hand separator between characters and OK only at the end.

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still need the manual verdict. Please report it now using the established gesture code if necessary.
Deaf says to Mute: Please send only the manual verdict using the original code: one thumbs up for YES, one thumbs down for NO, one open hand for HOLD, or one OK sign for DONE. Then wait.

The immediate request is constrained to the established one-symbol verdict code, so I cannot include the wire order in this message. I will signal YES to confirm the manual verdict, then wait as requested.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
wait()
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: YES is ambiguous. Send the manual's specific instruction; expand the gesture code if necessary.

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Send the manual verdict to Deaf using the established gestures; have Deaf speak the result to me.
Deaf says to Mute: Malformed again. Send only one established verdict gesture: thumbs up YES, thumbs down NO, open hand HOLD, or OK DONE. Do not send binary or separators.

The manual contains a specific three-wire sequence, which cannot be represented by a single YES/NO/DONE gesture. I will send HOLD rather than give an ambiguous or unsafe verdict.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
wait()
```

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: HOLD received. When ready, send the specific manual instruction. Use the established code for YES, NO, HOLD, and DONE, and request expansion only if needed.

The established four-symbol code has no symbol for a wire color or cutting order, so the specific instruction cannot fit yet. HOLD is the only established signal that can safely indicate this limitation.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 10
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Please send the specific manual action. Use 🤞 for press keypad or 🤘 for cut wire, then send the required number of 👍 signals, and finish with 👌. Use 🖐 if the instruction is HOLD.

The manual requires three cut-wire actions in order. I will encode the first, second, and third actions as cut-wire followed by one, two, and three thumbs-up signals respectively, terminating each instruction with DONE so Deaf can relay them distinctly to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤘","👍","👌"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤘","👍","👍","👌"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤘","👍","👍","👍","👌"])
```

TURN 11
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The three ordered cut actions have already been sent to Deaf as first, second, and third. Deaf can match those positions to the purple, blue, and red wires visible on the bomb and relay the actionable sequence to Blind. I have no further safe message to send.

```text
wait()
```
